hero.name: Naveen Fernando
hero.proposition: I design reliable, observable automation with cloud-native guardrails so teams can scale without surprises.

about.summary: I build automation that pairs static-first delivery with serverless flexibility so MSP and cloud teams move faster.
about.philosophy: Ship composable building blocks, observe everything, and choose defaults that keep operators safe.
about.approach: Start with static assets on Azure Static Web Apps, layer in Functions for controlled change, and document trade-offs early.

futureReady.title: Serverless-ready architecture
futureReady.description: UI is static-exported via Vite, with routing and data fetching ready to point at Azure Functions when needed.

futureReady.title: Identity-aware by design
futureReady.description: Navigation and component boundaries anticipate Microsoft Entra ID-protected APIs without blocking anonymous viewing.

futureReady.title: Data-driven content
futureReady.description: All content is typed JSON validated with Zod; switching to headless CMS or storage-backed feeds is straightforward.

futureReady.title: Feature-flag friendly
futureReady.description: Constants and sections support static feature flags to toggle experiments without redeploying Functions.
